description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain activation lifecycle, specifically testing deactivation on idle behavior and stress scenarios. It defines a test class 'DeactivateOnIdleTests' with multiple test methods that initialize a test cluster, perform grain interactions, and verify deactivation mechanisms.

classes.name: DeactivateOnIdleTests
classes.description: A test class containing various unit tests for Orleans grain deactivation on idle, including stress tests and non-existent activation scenarios.

methods.description: Disposes the test cluster and stops all silos.
